A_ServiceDistribution: Service entrance assembly: 208Y/120V 3PH 4W, parallel (2)4#3/0 in 2"C to NEMA 3R meter base and 12x12 wireway; coordinate with Duke Energy.
Panels A & B (225A MLO, 42-ckt) and two 200A NEMA 3R fused switches per E-4; furnish/install responsibility pending confirmation.
Feeders 4#3/0,#6G,2"C each switch to Panel A/B; grounding electrode system #2 CU with 20' Ufer; #6 telecom bond to MGB; arc flash labels.
B_BranchPower: Branch circuits per Panel A/B schedules with receptacles, GFCI/WP devices, J-boxes and floor boxes; G.C.-noted devices furnished and installed by APT.
Equipment connections: RTU-1/RTU-2 at unit disconnects, water heater, exhaust fans, ceiling fans, battery chargers, mini-tune, drink machine, drinking fountain, fridge.
Sign circuits A-6, A-14, A-16, A-18 with final connections; landscape control receptacle B-28; display baseflex J-boxes with 6' flex.
C_LightingControls: Lighting fixtures: furnish and install responsibility not yet decided; to be confirmed prior to contract.
Lighting controls: contactor enclosure (6 contactors) fed from B-25, photocell, motion/occupancy sensors, open/close pushbutton; conduit, wiring and functional testing.
Fixture types: A, B, C, E, F, K, M, N interior; D, G, J, L, S1, S2, SITE LIGHT exterior and site.
D_SiteLightingUnderground: Site lighting circuits A-15, A-17, A-19 through SITE contactor; underground conduit and wire to site poles per confirmed pole count.
Underground PVC Sch 40 with RGS long-radius risers; telephone service entrance conduit to utility point of connection.
Allowances: 20 LF #2 CU concrete-encased electrode; site underground conduit footage not dimensioned, allowance to be established.
E_LowVoltage: 2" empty conduit with pull wire phone board to roof deck; 1" empty conduits and J-boxes with pull wire for alarm and door access.
3/4" FRT plywood backboard, PVC phone stub-up, EAS dual surface wireway at storefront, 3/4" landscape control stub-out.
Control wiring in 1/2" conduit to RTUs, data concentrator and alarm interface module mounting, thermostat mounting; data/phone cabling by others.
F_Coordination: Coordinate with Duke Energy, telco, AutoZone vendors and HVAC contractor; Sunshine 811 locates prior to excavation.
Secure permits and utility fees per spec reimbursement terms; 72-hour notice to AutoZone Construction for tested operations.
Field testing, as-built documentation, arc flash labeling and one-year warranty correction period.
